PDF Merge — combine PDFs in your browser

PDF Merge is a free, in-browser tool for developers, analysts and writers that combines several PDF files into one document, in the order you arrange them. No file is ever uploaded to a server, so a confidential contract or invoice never leaves your machine. It is free forever, with no account and no cost of any kind.

Get started with PDF Merge

How to merge PDFs

Drop two or more PDF files onto the page, drag them into the order you want, and choose Merge. The combined file downloads straight back to your computer. Because the merge happens locally in your browser, the tool also works with no network connection once the page has loaded. See the getting-started guide for a full walkthrough, or try the other free tools on the site.

What it costs

Nothing. PDF Merge is free forever and open source. There is no paid tier, no usage limit, and no account to create — the tool is 100% free to use. Read the privacy note to see why nothing is uploaded.
